hook: One notebook classifier. Thirteen weeks later, an agent fleet in production.
body:
This trailer follows TicketFlow, a support-ticket service, from its first Messages API call to a governed fleet of agents.

Along the way: AsyncAnthropic when traffic spikes, the Batch API and prompt caching when finance asks about cost, tool use, format drift, checkpointing, orchestrators, MCP servers, hooks, prompt-injection defence and error routing.

Built for developers preparing for the Claude Certified Developer – Foundations (CCDV-F) exam, or shipping Claude into real services.

🔊 Turn the sound on for the walkthrough.

The full CCDV-F prep course builds TicketFlow chapter by chapter, with a practice exam:
